line: It's all to you, a word or two before you go.
I pray you, in your letters, when you shall these unlucky deeds relate,
the Venetian introduced the state, I took by the throat the circumcised dog and smote him.
This did I fear, I thought he had no weapon, for he was great of heart.
Oh, Spartan dog, more fell than anguish, hunger, or the sea.
Graziano, keep the house and seize upon the fortunes of the moor, for they succeed to you.
The time, the place, the torture will enforce it.
Myself will straight aboard, and to the state, this heavy act with heavy heart relate.
My part to my title and my perfect soul shall manifest me rightly.
